signal_rule: A decision from closed UTC data day D is available strictly after the end of D. It never controls PnL earned during D.
execution_rule: Use the first captured price timestamp at or after signal_available_at. If only daily spot data are complete, use the next daily open strictly after the availability estimate, with an explicit venue proxy label.
historical_availability: Observed build completion when archived; otherwise explicit next-day UTC availability estimate, never a claimed historical event timestamp.
identity_rule: Every active return and fill references a concrete symbol and source price rows keyed by symbol and timestamp. BASE and selected governance candidates are not economic holdings.
accounting_rule: gross = executed exposure at interval start * (identified end price / identified start price - 1); net = gross - fees - slippage - borrow - funding.
cost_rule: Transition fees and slippage apply only to actual executed changes; funding/borrow apply only to held exposure. Missing venue funding is an explicit proxy, never an observed zero.
dashboard_rule: model_index is the cumulative product of causal net returns. Model exposure is the exposure that earned that interval. Account performance is accepted only from its separate exchange-native ledger.
reproduction_rule: All input bytes, source code, configuration, versions and source timestamps are frozen and SHA256 verified. Original-build reproduction and a new candidate are separate verdicts.
